title: Show, turn, move
prompt: Do three things in order: show the robot, turn it 180 degrees, then move it 30 across and 30 down.
hints: Each call goes on its own line, in the order the robot should do them.

docs.name: show() / hide()
docs.what: Makes the robot visible or invisible. No arguments; returns nothing.

docs.name: rotate(degrees)
docs.what: Turns the robot by that many degrees. Takes one number; returns nothing.

docs.name: move(x, y)
docs.what: Moves the robot by x across and y down. Takes two numbers; returns nothing.
